title.narrative: Capacity building & Tech support for Climate Resilient Infrastructure in Sikkim

description.narrative: Capacity building and technical support for improving skills for management and construction of climate resilient infrastructure development projects in Sikkim. The overall aim of the project is to build-up capacity of an Indian research and teaching organization (Sikkim University) and to various stakeholders involved in building climate resilient infrastructure projects in Sikkim using Norwegian method of Tunnelling (NMT). The intended outcome of the project will be enhancement of competence in using modern techniques such as NMT for underground construction in an environmentally friendly manner. Through such initiatives climate resilient infrastructure projects can be constructed in a safe and cost-effective manner for sustainable development. The target group will be the researchers/scientists from Sikkim University in addition to the various stakeholders such as NHPC and Wapcos which are involved in building infrastructure in the state of Sikkim.
